name: UpdateRecordPlan

parameters.description_en: The ID of the recording plan. You can call [QueryRecordPlans](~~107896~~) to query the ID.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the recording plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107896.html to query the ID
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.description_en:
The name of the recording plan.

The name must be fewer than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:).
parameters.description_zh:
录像计划名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）。
parameters.help_en:
